text_block_list.text:
On the walk back from hanging out with Nakayama Festa,
we heard the faint mewing of a cat from somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're hiding in those bushes, aren't you?
...What, are you hungry or something?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's pretty skinny... Must be a stray.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, keep an eye on that cat.
...I'm gonna step away for a bit.
Meanwhile, I called the city's animal rescue center. ...Just as I hung up, she returned with some kitten milk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Here... drink up.
...Ah, you can't relax with me hovering around, huh?

Nakayama Festa sets down the dish and steps back a bit.
Though still wary, the cat began lapping up the milk.
choice_data_list: You really know your cats, huh?
You really know your cats, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. ...I'm just a bit
used to taking care of small animals.
When I stepped closer to check on its injury, the cat bolted away in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"She's totally on guard around us...
...She must've been through a lot."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: In a dog-eat-dog world, the only one you can trust is yourself... I get it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe she didn't need any help after all.

However, if the injury worsens, it could be life-threatening.
I told Nakayama Festa that even if it's meddlesome,
I want to help and can't just leave it be.
choice_data_list: This is when you need help!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ......Yeah, yeah, fine, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No choice. ...Let's go after them!

After searching for nearly half a day,
I finally found the cat in the park bushes—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...We'll flank them.
You chase, and I'll cut them off ahead."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that cat,
it'll definitely head over here where there are fewer people...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: !! Alright, bingo.

Just as Nakayama Festa predicted,
the chance to rescue the cat has presented itself.
...I'll leave the rest to her.

Nakayama Festa dropped to one knee
to lower her eye level as much as possible.
The cat stayed right where it was, watching her intently.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(You did well staying all on your own until you reached this point.
You've lived without relying on anyone, haven't you?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (You're just like I used to be. Unable to fit in with the pack, before you knew it, a stray who pushes everyone away.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(...Though, things are a little different now.
Leaning on your shoulder once in a while... ain't so bad.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If it's someone worthy of your trust, that is.
...See and judge for yourself.
The stray cat stared at Nakayama Festa for a while. Then, as if they had reached an understanding, it slowly walked up to her...!

It's almost time for the staff from the animal shelter
to come pick it up.
The stray cat is behaving peacefully...
choice_data_list: That takes a load off our minds.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You really are a busybody, aren't you...

It wasn't just sympathy. Somehow...
the stray cat overlapped
in my mind with Nakayama Festa.
choice_data_list: Because its noble demeanor reminded me of you.
Because that noble air reminded me of you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
......Heh.
...What the heck is that...
choice_data_list: Let's go check on the cat every now and then!
I hope this cat finds happiness...
I hope this cat finds happiness...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
......Heh.
...What the heck is that...
choice_data_list: Let's go check on the cat every now and then!
I hope this cat finds happiness...
I hope this cat finds happiness...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if I feel like it.
You'll probably forget about us in no time, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, you little.
Lick the milk, not my hand."
choice_data_list: She says she wants to see you again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Is that right? You sure are mercenary.
The cat pressed its forehead against Nakayama Festa as if begging for pets. When I chuckled at the sight, she shot me a sharp glare!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Drink plenty of milk, get a good night's sleep, and—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Heh, look. We're in a dream. ...Isn't that how this works?

So as not to wake the sleeping cat,
the two of them spent their time quietly...
